title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
premise: On an Arctic voyage, the explorer Robert Walton rescues a dying stranger, Victor Frankenstein, who tells how his obsession with the secret of life led to disaster.

moments.title: The creature wakes
moments.happened: Victor brings his creature to life, is horrified by it, and flees, leaving it alone.
alternatives: Victor stays and cares for the creature

moments.title: Justine’s trial
moments.happened: Victor’s little brother William is found dead. The servant Justine is blamed and executed while Victor stays silent.
alternatives: Victor tells the truth at the trial

moments.title: The cottage in the woods
moments.happened: The creature tells how the De Lacey family, whom he secretly helped, drove him away in fear.
alternatives: The creature never finds the cottage
Old De Lacey speaks for him

moments.title: A companion
moments.happened: The creature asks for a companion and promises to vanish with her forever. Victor agrees.
alternatives: The creature asks for a friend instead

moments.title: The island workshop
moments.happened: On a Scottish island Victor tears apart the half-made companion as the creature watches.
alternatives: The creature stops him in time
Victor sails away and abandons both

moments.title: The wedding night
moments.happened: On his wedding night Victor guards himself, but it is Elizabeth who is attacked.
alternatives: Elizabeth meets the creature and talks to it

moments.title: Into the ice
moments.happened: Victor pursues the creature across the frozen north, where Walton finds him.
alternatives: The creature turns back to help him
